User2026-10-11T18:28:44.605Z

I'd like to create an application that addresses the following problem: how to park a given set of cars/vehicles in a garage/barn of a specified size? This turns out to be a somewhat tricky problem once the garage becomes larger than one that will simply accomodate vehicles parked behind their respective doors in one rank. In larger buildings you can angle the vehicles and/or park them behind each other, and so on. When planning a new garage building it's not entirely obvious how many vehciles of what size you can get in, and in what configuration. The arrangement of doors also has an impact on the vehicle payload and how they can be parked. Key to determining where vehicles can park is their turning circle: basically you have to simulate the car driving in through the door then turning with whatever turning radius it has, backing up and so on, all leaving clearance around the walls, door jambs and other vehicles. The idea I have for how to help solve this problem (select the size, door configuration for a proposed garage vs the required vehicle payload) was to make an application that lets you simulate the parking. My vision is that this will be a web application (browser side code only, static hosted on the server) that uses some sort of 2D animation. The user would be able to enter the proposed building size and door arrangement, along with a selection of vehicles (perhaps they can pick from small, medium and large cars as a starting point). Then they could click to run the simulation and the "cars" would drive in the door/doors, turning according to their simulated turning circle and park in the building. It might be necessary to provide a hint from the user as to the requested parking arrangement, otherwise it might be hard to pick the best one. Or perhaps all possible arrangements could be simulated. I'm not sure about that. Anyway, the idea is that by playing around with the variables and running the simulation several times, the user can get an idea how their proposed building would work to accomodate their vehicle collection. Hopefully this makes sense!

// Oriented-box geometry. All units are feet, angles are radians.
// An OBB is { cx, cy, hx, hy, c, s, r } where (c, s) is the unit vector of its
// local x axis, hx/hy are half extents and r is the bounding-circle radius.

export function makeObb(cx, cy, hx, hy, th = 0) {
  return { cx, cy, hx, hy, c: Math.cos(th), s: Math.sin(th), r: Math.hypot(hx, hy) };
}

// Axis-aligned rectangle from corner coordinates.
export function rectObb(x0, y0, x1, y1) {
  const xa = Math.min(x0, x1), xb = Math.max(x0, x1);
  const ya = Math.min(y0, y1), yb = Math.max(y0, y1);
  return makeObb((xa + xb) / 2, (ya + yb) / 2, (xb - xa) / 2, (yb - ya) / 2, 0);
}

// Separating-axis test for two OBBs.
export function obbOverlap(a, b) {
  const dx = b.cx - a.cx, dy = b.cy - a.cy;
  const rr = a.r + b.r;
  if (dx * dx + dy * dy > rr * rr) return false;
  // Axes of a.
  let ab = Math.abs(a.c * b.c + a.s * b.s); // |ax . bx|
  let ab2 = Math.abs(a.c * -b.s + a.s * b.c); // |ax . by|
  if (Math.abs(dx * a.c + dy * a.s) > a.hx + b.hx * ab + b.hy * ab2) return false;
  const ab3 = Math.abs(-a.s * b.c + a.c * b.s); // |ay . bx|
  const ab4 = Math.abs(a.s * b.s + a.c * b.c); // |ay . by|
  if (Math.abs(-dx * a.s + dy * a.c) > a.hy + b.hx * ab3 + b.hy * ab4) return false;
  // Axes of b.
  if (Math.abs(dx * b.c + dy * b.s) > b.hx + a.hx * ab + a.hy * ab3) return false;
  if (Math.abs(-dx * b.s + dy * b.c) > b.hy + a.hx * ab2 + a.hy * ab4) return false;
  return true;
}

export function obbCorners(o) {
  const ux = o.c * o.hx, uy = o.s * o.hx;
  const vx = -o.s * o.hy, vy = o.c * o.hy;
  return [
    [o.cx + ux + vx, o.cy + uy + vy],
    [o.cx - ux + vx, o.cy - uy + vy],
    [o.cx - ux - vx, o.cy - uy - vy],
    [o.cx + ux - vx, o.cy + uy - vy],
  ];
}

// True if every corner of the OBB lies inside the axis-aligned box.
export function obbInsideRect(o, x0, y0, x1, y1) {
  const ex = Math.abs(o.c) * o.hx + Math.abs(o.s) * o.hy;
  const ey = Math.abs(o.s) * o.hx + Math.abs(o.c) * o.hy;
  return o.cx - ex >= x0 && o.cx + ex <= x1 && o.cy - ey >= y0 && o.cy + ey <= y1;
}

export function normAngle(a) {
  a %= 2 * Math.PI;
  return a < 0 ? a + 2 * Math.PI : a;
}

export function angleDiff(a, b) {
  const d = Math.abs(normAngle(a) - normAngle(b));
  return Math.min(d, 2 * Math.PI - d);
}

import { makeObb } from './geometry.js';

// Typical dimensions in feet. Width is the body width (doors closed, mirrors
// excluded); mirrorWidth is the overall width across the mirrors.
// turningCircle is the published curb-to-curb turning diameter.
export const PRESETS = {
  small: {
    label: 'Small car (compact sedan)',
    length: 15.1, width: 5.9, mirrorWidth: 6.8, wheelbase: 8.9, frontOverhang: 3.0, turningCircle: 36.4,
  },
  medium: {
    label: 'Medium (compact SUV)',
    length: 15.3, width: 6.1, mirrorWidth: 7.0, wheelbase: 8.8, frontOverhang: 3.0, turningCircle: 36.0,
  },
  large: {
    label: 'Large SUV',
    length: 17.6, width: 6.7, mirrorWidth: 7.8, wheelbase: 10.1, frontOverhang: 3.2, turningCircle: 39.0,
  },
  pickup: {
    label: 'Full-size pickup (crew cab)',
    length: 19.4, width: 6.7, mirrorWidth: 8.0, wheelbase: 12.1, frontOverhang: 3.1, turningCircle: 47.8,
  },
  sports: {
    label: 'Sports car',
    length: 14.8, width: 6.2, mirrorWidth: 6.9, wheelbase: 8.0, frontOverhang: 3.3, turningCircle: 36.0,
  },
};

export const COLORS = ['#e4572e', '#2e86ab', '#f3a712', '#6a994e', '#a8577e', '#4c5b8c', '#c96f3b', '#3a9e9e'];

let nextId = 1;
export function newVehicle(presetKey, index = 0) {
  const p = PRESETS[presetKey] || PRESETS.medium;
  return {
    id: nextId++,
    name: p.label.replace(/\s*\(.*\)/, ''),
    preset: presetKey,
    length: p.length,
    width: p.width,
    mirrorWidth: p.mirrorWidth,
    wheelbase: p.wheelbase,
    frontOverhang: p.frontOverhang,
    turningCircle: p.turningCircle,
    color: COLORS[index % COLORS.length],
    pin: null, // optional user-chosen parking pose { x, y, th }
  };
}

export function syncNextId(vehicles) {
  for (const v of vehicles) nextId = Math.max(nextId, v.id + 1);
}

// Derived geometry. The reference point is the centre of the rear axle,
// which is the point the kinematic (bicycle) model rotates about.
export function vehicleModel(v) {
  const rearOverhang = Math.max(0, v.length - v.wheelbase - v.frontOverhang);
  const track = v.width * 0.86;
  const rc = v.turningCircle / 2;
  // Outer front wheel traces the curb-to-curb circle:
  //   rc^2 = (R + track/2)^2 + wheelbase^2
  const rMin = Math.max(v.wheelbase * 0.6, Math.sqrt(Math.max(rc * rc - v.wheelbase * v.wheelbase, 1)) - track / 2);
  return {
    ...v,
    rearOverhang,
    track,
    rMin,
    maxSteer: Math.atan(v.wheelbase / rMin),
    // Body box centre offset from the rear axle, along the heading.
    bodyOffset: (v.wheelbase + v.frontOverhang - rearOverhang) / 2,
    // Mirrors sit roughly at the A-pillars.
    mirrorOffset: v.wheelbase - Math.min(2.4, v.wheelbase * 0.3),
    mirrorDepth: 0.7,
  };
}

// Body box at pose, with optional inflation (longitudinal, lateral) per side.
export function bodyObb(m, x, y, th, inflLong = 0, inflLat = 0) {
  const c = Math.cos(th), s = Math.sin(th);
  return makeObb(x + c * m.bodyOffset, y + s * m.bodyOffset, m.length / 2 + inflLong, m.width / 2 + inflLat, th);
}

export function mirrorObb(m, x, y, th, infl = 0) {
  const c = Math.cos(th), s = Math.sin(th);
  return makeObb(x + c * m.mirrorOffset, y + s * m.mirrorOffset, m.mirrorDepth / 2 + infl, m.mirrorWidth / 2 + infl, th);
}

import { rectObb } from './geometry.js';

// Coordinate system: the building interior spans x in [0, width] (left to
// right) and y in [0, depth] (front to back). Walls sit outside the interior.
// Door offsets are measured from the left end of the front/back walls and
// from the front end of the left/right walls.

export const WALLS = ['front', 'back', 'left', 'right'];

export const INWARD = { front: Math.PI / 2, back: -Math.PI / 2, left: 0, right: Math.PI };

export function defaultConfig() {
  return {
    building: { width: 36, depth: 30, wallThickness: 0.5 },
    doors: [
      { wall: 'front', offset: 3, width: 9 },
      { wall: 'front', offset: 15, width: 9 },
      { wall: 'front', offset: 27, width: 9 },
    ],
    obstacles: [],
    settings: { clearance: 0.75, parkGap: 2.5, endGap: 1.0, apron: 30, allowAngled: false },
    vehicles: [],
  };
}

export function wallLength(b, wall) {
  return wall === 'front' || wall === 'back' ? b.width : b.depth;
}

export function buildWorld(config) {
  const { width: W, depth: D } = config.building;
  const t = config.building.wallThickness ?? 0.5;
  const apron = Math.max(0, config.settings.apron);

  const doors = config.doors
    .map((d, i) => {
      const len = wallLength(config.building, d.wall);
      const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(len, d.offset));
      const b = Math.max(a, Math.min(len, d.offset + d.width));
      return { ...d, index: i, a, b, width: b - a };
    })
    .filter((d) => d.width > 0.1)
    .map((d) => {
      const mid = (d.a + d.b) / 2;
      const center = {
        front: [mid, 0], back: [mid, D], left: [0, mid], right: [W, mid],
      }[d.wall];
      return { ...d, center, inward: INWARD[d.wall] };
    });

  const obstacles = [];
  // Walls, with door gaps cut out. Front/back walls own the corners.
  const addWall = (wall, from, to, rect) => {
    const gaps = doors.filter((d) => d.wall === wall).map((d) => [d.a, d.b]).sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]);
    let pos = from;
    for (const [a, b] of gaps) {
      if (a > pos) obstacles.push({ kind: 'wall', obb: rect(pos, a) });
      pos = Math.max(pos, b);
    }
    if (to > pos) obstacles.push({ kind: 'wall', obb: rect(pos, to) });
  };
  addWall('front', -t, W + t, (a, b) => rectObb(a, -t, b, 0));
  addWall('back', -t, W + t, (a, b) => rectObb(a, D, b, D + t));
  addWall('left', 0, D, (a, b) => rectObb(-t, a, 0, b));
  addWall('right', 0, D, (a, b) => rectObb(W, a, W + t, b));

  for (const o of config.obstacles || []) {
    if (o.w > 0 && o.d > 0) obstacles.push({ kind: 'obstacle', obb: rectObb(o.x, o.y, o.x + o.w, o.y + o.d), label: o.label });
  }

  const has = (w) => doors.some((d) => d.wall === w);
  const bounds = {
    x0: -t - (has('left') ? apron : 0),
    x1: W + t + (has('right') ? apron : 0),
    y0: -t - (has('front') ? apron : 0),
    y1: D + t + (has('back') ? apron : 0),
  };

  return { W, D, t, apron, doors, obstacles, bounds, settings: config.settings };
}

// Hybrid-A*-style search over (x, y, heading) for a car-like vehicle.
//
// Headings are discretised into NTH bins and every motion primitive turns
// the vehicle by exactly 0 or +/-1 bin, so headings stay exact while x/y
// remain continuous. The search is run as a Dijkstra flood from the start
// poses, which yields every pose the vehicle can reach (and the cheapest
// manoeuvre to get there) in a single pass.

import { makeObb, obbOverlap, rectObb } from './geometry.js';

export const NTH = 72;
export const DTH = (2 * Math.PI) / NTH;
const MAX_STATES = 3_000_000;

const COS = new Float64Array(NTH);
const SIN = new Float64Array(NTH);
for (let i = 0; i < NTH; i++) {
  COS[i] = Math.cos(i * DTH);
  SIN[i] = Math.sin(i * DTH);
}

export function headingBin(th) {
  return ((Math.round(th / DTH) % NTH) + NTH) % NTH;
}

const COST = { reverse: 1.4, steer: 0.05, switchDir: 6 };

// Pose after travelling arc length s (signed by dir) with curvature kappa.
export function arcPose(x, y, th, dir, kappa, s) {
  if (Math.abs(kappa) < 1e-9) {
    return [x + dir * s * Math.cos(th), y + dir * s * Math.sin(th), th];
  }
  const th2 = th + dir * kappa * s;
  return [x + (Math.sin(th2) - Math.sin(th)) / kappa, y - (Math.cos(th2) - Math.cos(th)) / kappa, th2];
}

function buildPrimitives(model, cell) {
  const prims = [];
  const sTight = model.rMin * DTH;
  const steps = [
    { kappa: 0, s: Math.max(sTight, cell * 1.5), dth: 0 },
    { kappa: 1 / model.rMin, s: sTight, dth: 1 },
    { kappa: -1 / model.rMin, s: sTight, dth: -1 },
    { kappa: 1 / (2 * model.rMin), s: 2 * sTight, dth: 1 },
    { kappa: -1 / (2 * model.rMin), s: 2 * sTight, dth: -1 },
  ];
  for (const dir of [1, -1]) {
    for (const st of steps) {
      const nsub = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(st.s / Math.min(0.5, cell)));
      // Per start heading: offsets (dx, dy, cos, sin) of each sub-pose.
      const tab = new Float64Array(NTH * nsub * 4);
      for (let i = 0; i < NTH; i++) {
        const th = i * DTH;
        for (let k = 1; k <= nsub; k++) {
          const [px, py, pth] = arcPose(0, 0, th, dir, st.kappa, (st.s * k) / nsub);
          const o = (i * nsub + k - 1) * 4;
          tab[o] = px;
          tab[o + 1] = py;
          tab[o + 2] = Math.cos(pth);
          tab[o + 3] = Math.sin(pth);
        }
      }
      const dth = dir * st.dth;
      const cost = st.s * (dir < 0 ? COST.reverse : 1) + (st.kappa ? COST.steer * st.s : 0);
      prims.push({ dir, kappa: st.kappa, s: st.s, dth, nsub, tab, cost });
    }
  }
  return prims;
}

class Heap {
  constructor() {
    this.k = new Float64Array(1024);
    this.v = new Int32Array(1024);
    this.n = 0;
  }
  push(key, val) {
    if (this.n === this.k.length) {
      const k = new Float64Array(this.n * 2); k.set(this.k); this.k = k;
      const v = new Int32Array(this.n * 2); v.set(this.v); this.v = v;
    }
    let i = this.n++;
    const K = this.k, V = this.v;
    while (i > 0) {
      const p = (i - 1) >> 1;
      if (K[p] <= key) break;
      K[i] = K[p]; V[i] = V[p]; i = p;
    }
    K[i] = key; V[i] = val;
  }
  pop() {
    const K = this.k, V = this.v;
    const top = V[0];
    this.topKey = K[0];
    const n = --this.n;
    if (n > 0) {
      const key = K[n], val = V[n];
      let i = 0;
      for (;;) {
        let c = 2 * i + 1;
        if (c >= n) break;
        if (c + 1 < n && K[c + 1] < K[c]) c++;
        if (K[c] >= key) break;
        K[i] = K[c]; V[i] = V[c]; i = c;
      }
      K[i] = key; V[i] = val;
    }
    return top;
  }
}

// Shared state buffers, reused between searches over the same grid size.
let bufCache = null;
function buffers(n) {
  if (!bufCache || bufCache.n !== n) {
    bufCache = {
      n,
      g: new Float32Array(n),
      px: new Float32Array(n),
      py: new Float32Array(n),
      parent: new Int32Array(n),
      prim: new Int8Array(n),
      closed: new Uint8Array(n),
    };
  }
  const b = bufCache;
  b.g.fill(Infinity);
  b.closed.fill(0);
  return b;
}

export class Search {
  // obstacles: array of OBBs the vehicle must not touch (walls, posts,
  // parked vehicles). Clearance inflates the moving vehicle.
  constructor(world, model, obstacles) {
    this.world = world;
    this.m = model;
    this.obstacles = obstacles;
    this.clearance = Math.max(0, world.settings.clearance);
    const { x0, y0, x1, y1 } = world.bounds;
    const area = (x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0);
    this.cell = Math.max(0.5, Math.sqrt((area * NTH) / MAX_STATES));
    this.nx = Math.ceil((x1 - x0) / this.cell);
    this.ny = Math.ceil((y1 - y0) / this.cell);
    this.prims = buildPrimitives(model, this.cell);
    this.body = makeObb(0, 0, model.length / 2 + this.clearance, model.width / 2 + this.clearance, 0);
    this.mirror = makeObb(0, 0, model.mirrorDepth / 2 + this.clearance, model.mirrorWidth / 2 + this.clearance, 0);
    this.envelope = rectObb(-world.t, -world.t, world.W + world.t, world.D + world.t);
  }

  // Collision test for the (clearance-inflated) vehicle with rear axle at
  // (x, y) and heading given by (c, s).
  collides(x, y, c, s) {
    const m = this.m, b = this.body, mi = this.mirror;
    b.cx = x + c * m.bodyOffset; b.cy = y + s * m.bodyOffset; b.c = c; b.s = s;
    // Stay within the modelled area (body only; clearance is for solid things).
    const { x0, y0, x1, y1 } = this.world.bounds;
    const ex = Math.abs(c) * m.length / 2 + Math.abs(s) * m.width / 2;
    const ey = Math.abs(s) * m.length / 2 + Math.abs(c) * m.width / 2;
    if (b.cx - ex < x0 || b.cx + ex > x1 || b.cy - ey < y0 || b.cy + ey > y1) return true;
    mi.cx = x + c * m.mirrorOffset; mi.cy = y + s * m.mirrorOffset; mi.c = c; mi.s = s;
    const obs = this.obstacles;
    for (let i = 0; i < obs.length; i++) {
      if (obbOverlap(b, obs[i]) || obbOverlap(mi, obs[i])) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  collidesPose(x, y, th) {
    return this.collides(x, y, Math.cos(th), Math.sin(th));
  }

  index(x, y, ith) {
    const ix = Math.floor((x - this.world.bounds.x0) / this.cell);
    const iy = Math.floor((y - this.world.bounds.y0) / this.cell);
    if (ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix >= this.nx || iy >= this.ny) return -1;
    return (iy * this.nx + ix) * NTH + ith;
  }

  // Entry poses just outside each door: driving in forwards and reversing in.
  startPoses() {
    const m = this.m, w = this.world;
    const poses = [];
    const gap = w.t + this.clearance + 0.3;
    for (const d of w.doors) {
      const ux = Math.cos(d.inward), uy = Math.sin(d.inward);
      const [cx, cy] = d.center;
      const fwd = gap + m.wheelbase + m.frontOverhang;
      poses.push({ x: cx - ux * fwd, y: cy - uy * fwd, ith: headingBin(d.inward), door: d.index });
      const rev = gap + m.rearOverhang;
      poses.push({ x: cx - ux * rev, y: cy - uy * rev, ith: headingBin(d.inward + Math.PI), door: d.index });
    }
    return poses.filter((p) => !this.collides(p.x, p.y, COS[p.ith], SIN[p.ith]));
  }

  // Dijkstra flood. Stops early when goalTest(x, y, ith) returns true and
  // returns that state index; otherwise returns -1 after exhausting the
  // reachable space (or maxExpansions).
  run(starts, { goalTest = null, maxExpansions = 4_000_000 } = {}) {
    const n = this.nx * this.ny * NTH;
    const B = buffers(n);
    const { g, px, py, parent, prim, closed } = B;
    this.B = B;
    const heap = new Heap();
    for (const p of starts) {
      const idx = this.index(p.x, p.y, p.ith);
      if (idx < 0) continue;
      g[idx] = 0; px[idx] = p.x; py[idx] = p.y; parent[idx] = -1; prim[idx] = -1;
      heap.push(0, idx);
    }
    const closedList = [];
    const prims = this.prims;
    const x0 = this.world.bounds.x0, y0 = this.world.bounds.y0, cell = this.cell, nx = this.nx, ny = this.ny;
    let expansions = 0;
    while (heap.n > 0 && expansions < maxExpansions) {
      const idx = heap.pop();
      if (closed[idx] || heap.topKey > g[idx]) continue;
      closed[idx] = 1;
      closedList.push(idx);
      expansions++;
      const ith = idx % NTH;
      const x = px[idx], y = py[idx];
      if (goalTest && goalTest(x, y, ith)) {
        this.closedList = closedList;
        return idx;
      }
      const gi = g[idx];
      const lastDir = prim[idx] >= 0 ? prims[prim[idx]].dir : 0;
      for (let p = 0; p < prims.length; p++) {
        const P = prims[p];
        const nth = (ith + P.dth + NTH) % NTH;
        const tab = P.tab, base = ith * P.nsub * 4;
        const last = base + (P.nsub - 1) * 4;
        const ex = x + tab[last], ey = y + tab[last + 1];
        const ix = Math.floor((ex - x0) / cell), iy = Math.floor((ey - y0) / cell);
        if (ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix >= nx || iy >= ny) continue;
        const nidx = (iy * nx + ix) * NTH + nth;
        if (closed[nidx]) continue;
        const cost = gi + P.cost + (lastDir && lastDir !== P.dir ? COST.switchDir : 0);
        if (cost >= g[nidx]) continue;
        let hit = false;
        for (let k = 0; k < P.nsub; k++) {
          const o = base + k * 4;
          if (this.collides(x + tab[o], y + tab[o + 1], tab[o + 2], tab[o + 3])) { hit = true; break; }
        }
        if (hit) continue;
        g[nidx] = cost; px[nidx] = ex; py[nidx] = ey; parent[nidx] = idx; prim[nidx] = p;
        heap.push(cost, nidx);
      }
    }
    this.closedList = closedList;
    this.expansions = expansions;
    return -1;
  }

  pose(idx) {
    const ith = idx % NTH;
    return { x: this.B.px[idx], y: this.B.py[idx], th: ith * DTH, ith };
  }

  cost(idx) {
    return this.B.g[idx];
  }

  // Dense pose samples along the path to idx: [{x, y, th, dir, steer}].
  path(idx) {
    const chain = [];
    for (let i = idx; i >= 0; i = this.B.parent[i]) chain.push(i);
    chain.reverse();
    const first = this.pose(chain[0]);
    const out = [{ x: first.x, y: first.y, th: first.th, dir: 0, steer: 0 }];
    for (let k = 1; k < chain.length; k++) {
      const a = this.pose(chain[k - 1]);
      const P = this.prims[this.B.prim[chain[k]]];
      const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(P.s / 0.25));
      const steer = Math.atan(this.m.wheelbase * P.kappa);
      for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        const [x, y, th] = arcPose(a.x, a.y, a.th, P.dir, P.kappa, (P.s * j) / n);
        out.push({ x, y, th, dir: P.dir, steer });
      }
      // Snap the segment end to the stored state to avoid drift.
      const b = this.pose(chain[k]);
      Object.assign(out[out.length - 1], { x: b.x, y: b.y, th: b.th });
    }
    return out;
  }
}

export { COS, SIN };

// Parks a list of vehicles one after another. Each vehicle floods the
// reachable pose space from the doors, then a parking pose is chosen
// (the user's pinned pose, or the best-scoring free spot).

import { obbOverlap, obbInsideRect, rectObb, makeObb, angleDiff } from './geometry.js';
import { vehicleModel, bodyObb, mirrorObb } from './vehicles.js';
import { buildWorld } from './world.js';
import { Search, NTH, DTH, headingBin } from './planner.js';

const AXIS_STEP = NTH / 4;

function staticObbs(world) {
  return world.obstacles.map((o) => o.obb);
}

function parkedObbs(list, exclude = -1) {
  const out = [];
  for (const p of list) {
    if (p.vi === exclude) continue;
    out.push(p.body, p.mirror);
  }
  return out;
}

// Is a parked vehicle at (x, y, th) leaving enough room around it?
function parkValid(world, m, x, y, th, parked) {
  const s = world.settings;
  const body = bodyObb(m, x, y, th, Math.max(0, s.endGap), Math.max(0, s.parkGap));
  const bare = bodyObb(m, x, y, th);
  if (!obbInsideRect(bare, 0, 0, world.W, world.D)) return false;
  for (const o of world.obstacles) if (obbOverlap(body, o.obb)) return false;
  for (const p of parked) if (obbOverlap(body, p.body)) return false;
  return true;
}

// Does the area just beyond a side of the box touch anything?
function sideTouches(box, side, probe, solids) {
  const along = side < 2;
  const sign = side % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const h = along ? box.hx : box.hy;
  const off = (h + probe / 2) * sign;
  const cx = box.cx + (along ? box.c * off : -box.s * off);
  const cy = box.cy + (along ? box.s * off : box.c * off);
  const slab = makeObb(cx, cy, along ? probe / 2 : box.hx * 0.8, along ? box.hy * 0.8 : probe / 2, Math.atan2(box.s, box.c));
  for (const o of solids) if (obbOverlap(slab, o)) return true;
  return false;
}

function doorLanes(world, laneDepth) {
  return world.doors.map((d) => {
    const { W, D } = world;
    const L = Math.min(laneDepth, d.wall === 'front' || d.wall === 'back' ? D : W);
    switch (d.wall) {
      case 'front': return rectObb(d.a, 0, d.b, L);
      case 'back': return rectObb(d.a, D - L, d.b, D);
      case 'left': return rectObb(0, d.a, L, d.b);
      default: return rectObb(W - L, d.a, W, d.b);
    }
  });
}

function chooseAuto(ctx, search, m, remaining) {
  const { world, parked, rng, noise } = ctx;
  const s = world.settings;
  const diag = Math.hypot(world.W, world.D);
  const solids = [...staticObbs(world), ...parked.map((p) => p.body)];
  const lanes = remaining > 0 ? doorLanes(world, ctx.laneDepth) : [];
  let best = -1, bestScore = -Infinity;
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const idx of search.closedList) {
    const ith = idx % NTH;
    if (!s.allowAngled && ith % AXIS_STEP !== 0) continue;
    const { x, y, th } = search.pose(idx);
    // Coarse de-duplication: one candidate per 0.5 ft cell and heading.
    const key = Math.round(x * 2) * 1e6 + Math.round(y * 2) * 100 + ith;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    if (!parkValid(world, m, x, y, th, parked)) continue;
    const box = bodyObb(m, x, y, th, Math.max(0, s.endGap), Math.max(0, s.parkGap));
    let depth = Infinity;
    for (const d of world.doors) depth = Math.min(depth, Math.hypot(box.cx - d.center[0], box.cy - d.center[1]));
    let touches = 0;
    for (let side = 0; side < 4; side++) if (sideTouches(box, side, 1.0, solids)) touches++;
    let laneHits = 0;
    for (const l of lanes) if (obbOverlap(box, l)) laneHits++;
    const offAxis = angleDiff(th, Math.round(th / (Math.PI / 2)) * (Math.PI / 2));
    let score = 2.0 * (depth / diag) + 0.6 * touches - 0.8 * laneHits - 0.8 * offAxis - 0.002 * search.cost(idx);
    if (noise) score += noise * rng();
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = idx; }
  }
  return best;
}

function choosePinned(search, pin) {
  const ith = headingBin(pin.th);
  let best = -1, bestD = 1.0;
  for (const idx of search.closedList) {
    if (idx % NTH !== ith) continue;
    const p = search.pose(idx);
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - pin.x, p.y - pin.y);
    if (d < bestD || (d === bestD && search.cost(idx) < search.cost(best))) { bestD = d; best = idx; }
  }
  return best;
}

function summarizePath(path) {
  let moves = 0, last = 0, dist = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
    if (path[i].dir !== last) { moves++; last = path[i].dir; }
    dist += Math.hypot(path[i].x - path[i - 1].x, path[i].y - path[i - 1].y);
  }
  return { moves, distance: dist };
}

// Can vehicle p drive out with the others in place?
function canExit(world, p, others) {
  const search = new Search(world, p.model, [...staticObbs(world), ...parkedObbs(others)]);
  const env = search.envelope;
  const test = (x, y, ith) => !obbOverlap(bodyObb(p.model, x, y, ith * DTH), env);
  return search.run([{ x: p.x, y: p.y, ith: headingBin(p.th) }], { goalTest: test, maxExpansions: 1_500_000 }) >= 0;
}

export function exitReport(world, parked) {
  const report = new Map();
  for (const p of parked) {
    const others = parked.filter((q) => q !== p);
    if (canExit(world, p, others)) { report.set(p.vi, { ok: true, blockedBy: [] }); continue; }
    const blockedBy = [];
    if (others.length <= 8) {
      for (const q of others) {
        if (canExit(world, p, others.filter((r) => r !== q))) blockedBy.push(q.vi);
      }
    }
    report.set(p.vi, { ok: false, blockedBy });
  }
  return report;
}

// config: the full app config. options: { order, rng, noise, checkExit, onProgress }
export function planLayout(config, options = {}) {
  const world = buildWorld(config);
  const vehicles = config.vehicles;
  const order = options.order || vehicles.map((_, i) => i);
  const rng = options.rng || Math.random;
  const laneDepth = Math.max(10, ...vehicles.map((v) => v.length)) + 2;
  const ctx = { world, parked: [], rng, noise: options.noise || 0, laneDepth };
  const results = vehicles.map((v) => ({ id: v.id, parked: false, reason: 'not attempted' }));
  // Pinned vehicles are parked first so the automatic ones work around them.
  const seq = [...order.filter((i) => vehicles[i].pin), ...order.filter((i) => !vehicles[i].pin)];

  seq.forEach((vi, n) => {
    const v = vehicles[vi];
    const m = vehicleModel(v);
    options.onProgress?.({ step: n, total: seq.length, name: v.name });
    const search = new Search(world, m, [...staticObbs(world), ...parkedObbs(ctx.parked)]);
    const starts = search.startPoses();
    if (!starts.length) {
      results[vi] = { id: v.id, parked: false, reason: 'cannot line up with any door (door too narrow or apron too short)' };
      return;
    }
    search.run(starts);
    const idx = v.pin ? choosePinned(search, v.pin) : chooseAuto(ctx, search, m, seq.length - n - 1);
    if (idx < 0) {
      results[vi] = {
        id: v.id, parked: false,
        reason: v.pin ? 'pinned spot cannot be reached' : 'no reachable spot with the required spacing',
      };
      return;
    }
    const pose = search.pose(idx);
    const path = search.path(idx);
    const entry = starts.find((s) => Math.abs(s.x - path[0].x) < 1e-3 && Math.abs(s.y - path[0].y) < 1e-3);
    ctx.parked.push({
      vi, model: m, x: pose.x, y: pose.y, th: pose.th,
      body: bodyObb(m, pose.x, pose.y, pose.th),
      mirror: mirrorObb(m, pose.x, pose.y, pose.th),
    });
    results[vi] = {
      id: v.id, parked: true, pose: { x: pose.x, y: pose.y, th: pose.th }, path,
      seq: n, door: entry ? entry.door : null,
      spacingOk: parkValid(world, m, pose.x, pose.y, pose.th, ctx.parked.slice(0, -1)),
      ...summarizePath(path),
    };
  });

  if (options.checkExit !== false && ctx.parked.length) {
    options.onProgress?.({ step: seq.length, total: seq.length, name: 'exit check' });
    const report = exitReport(world, ctx.parked);
    for (const [vi, r] of report) results[vi].exit = { ok: r.ok, blockedBy: r.blockedBy.map((j) => vehicles[j].id) };
  }

  const parkedCount = results.filter((r) => r.parked).length;
  const freeExit = results.filter((r) => r.parked && r.exit?.ok).length;
  return { results, parkedCount, freeExit, order: seq };
}

function sweptPath(world, m, path) {
  const c = Math.max(0, world.settings.clearance);

  return { obbs, x0, y0, x1, y1 };
}

function blocksSweep(box, sw) {
  if (box.cx + box.r < sw.x0 || box.cx - box.r > sw.x1 || box.cy + box.r < sw.y0 || box.cy - box.r > sw.y1) return false;
  for (const o of sw.obbs) if (obbOverlap(box, o)) return true;

  const lanes = remaining > 0 ? doorLanes(world, ctx.laneDepth) : [];

  let best = -1, bestScore = -Infinity;
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const idx of search.closedList) {
    const ith = idx % NTH;
    if (!s.allowAngled && ith % AXIS_STEP !== 0) continue;
    const { x, y, th } = search.pose(idx);
    // Coarse de-duplication: one candidate per 0.5 ft cell and heading.
    const key = `${Math.round(x * 2)},${Math.round(y * 2)},${ith}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    if (!parkValid(world, m, x, y, th, parked)) continue;
    const box = bodyObb(m, x, y, th, Math.max(0, s.endGap), Math.max(0, s.parkGap));
    let depth = Infinity;
    for (const d of world.doors) depth = Math.min(depth, Math.hypot(box.cx - d.center[0], box.cy - d.center[1]));
    let touches = 0;
    for (let side = 0; side < 4; side++) if (sideTouches(box, side, 1.0, solids)) touches++;
    let laneHits = 0;
    for (const l of lanes) if (obbOverlap(box, l)) laneHits++;
    const offAxis = angleDiff(th, Math.round(th / (Math.PI / 2)) * (Math.PI / 2)) * 180 / Math.PI;
    let score = W.depth * depth + W.touch * touches - W.lane * laneHits - W.offAxisDeg * offAxis - W.cost * search.cost(idx);
    if (sweeps.length) {
      const bare = bodyObb(m, x, y, th);
      for (const sw of sweeps) if (blocksSweep(bare, sw)) score -= W.blocks;
    }
    if (noise) score += noise * W.noise * rng();
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = idx; }
  }
  return best;
}

import { planLayout } from './layout.js';

// Higher is better: park as many as possible, then as many as can leave
// freely, then prefer fewer manoeuvres.
export function layoutScore(r) {
  const moves = r.results.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.parked ? x.moves : 0), 0);
  return r.parkedCount * 1e6 + r.freeExit * 1e3 - moves;
}

function mulberry32(seed) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0; seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function shuffle(a, rng) {
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}

// Trial 0 is the plain greedy layout in the user's order; later trials
// shuffle the order and add noise to the spot choice.
export function explore(config, { trials = 20, seed = 1, onProgress, onImproved } = {}) {
  const rng = mulberry32(seed);
  const n = config.vehicles.length;
  let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
  for (let t = 0; t < trials; t++) {
    const order = t === 0 ? [...Array(n).keys()] : shuffle([...Array(n).keys()], rng);
    const noise = t === 0 ? 0 : (t % 3) * 0.5 + 0.25;
    const r = planLayout(config, {
      order, rng, noise,
      onProgress: (p) => onProgress?.({ trial: t, trials, ...p }),
    });
    const sc = layoutScore(r);
    if (sc > bestScore) {
      best = { ...r, trial: t };
      bestScore = sc;
      onImproved?.(best);
    }
    if (best.parkedCount === n && best.freeExit === n && t >= 2) break;
  }
  return best;
}
EOF

import { planLayout } from './layout.js';
import { explore } from './explore.js';

self.onmessage = (e) => {
  const { type, config, id, trials } = e.data;
  try {
    if (type === 'plan') {
      const result = planLayout(config, { onProgress: (p) => self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', id, ...p }) });
      self.postMessage({ type: 'result', id, result });
    } else if (type === 'explore') {
      const result = explore(config, {
        trials,
        seed: (Math.random() * 2 ** 31) | 0,
        onProgress: (p) => self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', id, ...p }),
        onImproved: (best) => self.postMessage({ type: 'improved', id, parkedCount: best.parkedCount, freeExit: best.freeExit, trial: best.trial }),
      });
      self.postMessage({ type: 'result', id, result });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    self.postMessage({ type: 'error', id, message: String(err && err.stack || err) });
  }
};

import { obbCorners } from './geometry.js';
import { bodyObb, mirrorObb } from './vehicles.js';

function cssVar(name) {
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
}

export class Renderer {
  constructor(canvas) {
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    this.scale = 10;
    this.ox = 0;
    this.oy = 0;
  }

  resize() {
    const r = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    this.dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    this.w = r.width;
    this.h = r.height;
    this.canvas.width = Math.round(r.width * this.dpr);
    this.canvas.height = Math.round(r.height * this.dpr);
  }

  // Fit the world bounds (plus room for labels) into the canvas, y up.
  fit(bounds) {
    const pad = 36;
    const bw = bounds.x1 - bounds.x0, bh = bounds.y1 - bounds.y0;
    this.scale = Math.max(1, Math.min((this.w - 2 * pad) / bw, (this.h - 2 * pad) / bh));
    this.ox = (this.w - bw * this.scale) / 2 - bounds.x0 * this.scale;
    this.oy = (this.h + bh * this.scale) / 2 + bounds.y0 * this.scale;
  }

  toScreen(x, y) {
    return [this.ox + x * this.scale, this.oy - y * this.scale];
  }

  toWorld(sx, sy) {
    return [(sx - this.ox) / this.scale, (this.oy - sy) / this.scale];
  }

  worldTransform() {
    const d = this.dpr;
    this.ctx.setTransform(d * this.scale, 0, 0, -d * this.scale, d * this.ox, d * this.oy);
  }

  screenTransform() {
    this.ctx.setTransform(this.dpr, 0, 0, this.dpr, 0, 0);
  }

  px(n) {
    return n / this.scale;
  }

  // scene: { world, vehicles: [{ model, pose, steer, color, label, ghost, invalid, highlight, path }], options }
  draw(scene) {
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    const { world, options } = scene;
    const col = {
      bg: cssVar('--cv-bg'), apron: cssVar('--cv-apron'), floor: cssVar('--cv-floor'),
      grid: cssVar('--cv-grid'), grid5: cssVar('--cv-grid5'), wall: cssVar('--cv-wall'),
      door: cssVar('--cv-door'), obstacle: cssVar('--cv-obstacle'), text: cssVar('--cv-text'),
    };
    this.screenTransform();
    ctx.fillStyle = col.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.w, this.h);
    if (!world) return;

    this.worldTransform();
    const { bounds: b, W, D, t } = world;
    ctx.fillStyle = col.apron;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x0, b.y0, b.x1 - b.x0, b.y1 - b.y0);
    ctx.fillStyle = col.floor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, D);

    // Grid: 1 ft and 5 ft lines inside the building.
    ctx.lineWidth = this.px(1);
    for (const [step, color] of [[1, col.grid], [5, col.grid5]]) {
      if (step === 1 && this.scale < 6) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let x = step; x < W; x += step) { ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, D); }
      for (let y = step; y < D; y += step) { ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); }
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Door swings / openings.
    for (const d of world.doors) {
      const [cx, cy] = d.center;
      const horiz = d.wall === 'front' || d.wall === 'back';
      ctx.fillStyle = col.door + '33';
      if (horiz) ctx.fillRect(d.a, cy - (d.wall === 'front' ? t : 0), d.width, t);
      else ctx.fillRect(cx - (d.wall === 'left' ? t : 0), d.a, t, d.width);
      ctx.strokeStyle = col.door;
      ctx.lineWidth = this.px(2);
      ctx.setLineDash([this.px(6), this.px(4)]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (horiz) { ctx.moveTo(d.a, cy); ctx.lineTo(d.b, cy); } else { ctx.moveTo(cx, d.a); ctx.lineTo(cx, d.b); }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }

    for (const o of world.obstacles) {
      ctx.fillStyle = o.kind === 'wall' ? col.wall : col.obstacle;
      this.fillObb(o.obb);
    }

    // Paths underneath vehicles.
    if (options.showPaths) {
      for (const v of scene.vehicles) if (v.path) this.drawPath(v.path, v.color, v.pathUpTo);
    }
    for (const v of scene.vehicles) this.drawVehicle(v, options);

    // Labels in screen space.
    this.screenTransform();
    ctx.fillStyle = col.text;
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
    let [sx, sy] = this.toScreen(W / 2, D + t);
    ctx.fillText(`${fmtFt(W)} wide`, sx, sy - 4);
    [sx, sy] = this.toScreen(-t, D / 2);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx - 6, sy);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText(`${fmtFt(D)} deep`, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (const d of world.doors) {
      const off = 14 + t * this.scale;
      const u = [Math.cos(d.inward), Math.sin(d.inward)];
      const [dx, dy] = this.toScreen(d.center[0] - u[0] * off / this.scale, d.center[1] - u[1] * off / this.scale);
      ctx.fillStyle = col.door;
      ctx.fillText(`Door ${d.index + 1} · ${fmtFt(d.width)}`, dx, dy);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = col.text;
    for (const v of scene.vehicles) {
      if (!v.label) continue;
      const box = bodyObb(v.model, v.pose.x, v.pose.y, v.pose.th);
      const [lx, ly] = this.toScreen(box.cx, box.cy);
      ctx.font = '600 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
      ctx.strokeText(v.label, lx, ly);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1b1d21';
      ctx.fillText(v.label, lx, ly);
    }
  }

  fillObb(o) {
    const c = obbCorners(o);
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c[0][0], c[0][1]);
    for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) ctx.lineTo(c[i][0], c[i][1]);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  strokeObb(o) {
    const c = obbCorners(o);
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c[0][0], c[0][1]);
    for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) ctx.lineTo(c[i][0], c[i][1]);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  drawPath(path, color, upTo = path.length) {
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.lineWidth = this.px(2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color + 'aa';
    let i = 1;
    const n = Math.min(upTo, path.length);
    while (i < n) {
      const dir = path[i].dir;
      ctx.setLineDash(dir < 0 ? [this.px(5), this.px(4)] : []);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(path[i - 1].x, path[i - 1].y);
      while (i < n && path[i].dir === dir) { ctx.lineTo(path[i].x, path[i].y); i++; }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  drawVehicle(v, options) {
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    const m = v.model;
    const { x, y, th } = v.pose;
    const c = Math.cos(th), s = Math.sin(th);

    if (options.showClearance && !v.ghost) {
      const cl = options.clearance;
      ctx.strokeStyle = v.color + '88';
      ctx.lineWidth = this.px(1);
      ctx.setLineDash([this.px(3), this.px(3)]);
      this.strokeObb(bodyObb(m, x, y, th, cl, cl));
      this.strokeObb(mirrorObb(m, x, y, th, cl));
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(th);
    const rear = -m.rearOverhang, front = m.wheelbase + m.frontOverhang, hw = m.width / 2;
    const alpha = v.ghost ? 0.35 : 1;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

    // Wheels.
    const tw = 0.7, tl = 2.2, ht = m.track / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1b1d21';
    for (const [wx, wy, steer] of [[0, ht, 0], [0, -ht, 0], [m.wheelbase, ht, v.steer || 0], [m.wheelbase, -ht, v.steer || 0]]) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(wx, wy);
      ctx.rotate(steer);
      ctx.fillRect(-tl / 2, -tw / 2, tl, tw);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Mirrors.
    ctx.fillStyle = v.color;
    const mw = m.mirrorWidth / 2;
    ctx.fillRect(m.mirrorOffset - m.mirrorDepth / 2, hw - 0.1, m.mirrorDepth, mw - hw + 0.1);
    ctx.fillRect(m.mirrorOffset - m.mirrorDepth / 2, -mw, m.mirrorDepth, mw - hw + 0.1);

    // Body.
    roundRect(ctx, rear, -hw, front - rear, m.width, 1.0);
    ctx.fillStyle = v.color;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = this.px(v.highlight ? 3 : 1.2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = v.invalid ? '#c7392f' : v.highlight ? '#ffffff' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    if (v.ghost) ctx.setLineDash([this.px(5), this.px(3)]);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Windscreen and rear window.
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 30, 45, 0.55)';
    const ws = m.wheelbase - 0.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ws, -hw + 0.5); ctx.lineTo(ws + 1.0, -hw + 0.7); ctx.lineTo(ws + 1.0, hw - 0.7); ctx.lineTo(ws, hw - 0.5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(rear + 1.2 + (m.length > 18 ? 5 : 0), -hw + 0.7, 0.7, m.width - 1.4);

    // Headlights.
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 245, 200, 0.95)';
    ctx.fillRect(front - 0.35, -hw + 0.35, 0.3, 1.0);
    ctx.fillRect(front - 0.35, hw - 1.35, 0.3, 1.0);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (v.invalid) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#c7392f';
      ctx.lineWidth = this.px(2);
      this.strokeObb(bodyObb(m, x, y, th));
    }
  }
}

function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

export function fmtFt(v) {
  const ft = Math.floor(v + 1e-6);
  const inch = Math.round((v - ft) * 12);
  if (inch === 12) return `${ft + 1}'`;
  return inch ? `${ft}'${inch}"` : `${ft}'`;
}

import { defaultConfig, buildWorld, WALLS } from './world.js';
import { PRESETS, COLORS, newVehicle, vehicleModel, syncNextId, bodyObb } from './vehicles.js';
import { parkValid } from './layout.js';
import { headingBin, DTH } from './planner.js';
import { Renderer, fmtFt } from './render.js';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const STORAGE_KEY = 'parking-buddy-config';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- state

let config = loadConfig();
let world = buildWorld(config);
let result = null; // { ...planLayout result, snap: config used, mode, trials }
let stale = false;
let hoverId = null;
let drag = null;
const openDetails = new Set();

const renderer = new Renderer($('canvas'));
const anim = { playing: false, t: 0, timeline: null, last: 0 };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- config persistence

function exampleConfig() {
  const c = defaultConfig();
  c.vehicles = ['medium', 'large', 'small'].map((p, i) => newVehicle(p, i));
  return c;
}

function loadConfig() {
  const fromHash = location.hash.startsWith('#c=') ? decodeConfig(location.hash.slice(3)) : null;
  let c = fromHash;
  if (!c) {
    try { c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)); } catch { c = null; }
  }
  if (!c || !c.building || !Array.isArray(c.vehicles)) c = exampleConfig();
  const d = defaultConfig();
  c.settings = { ...d.settings, ...c.settings };
  c.obstacles ||= [];
  c.doors ||= [];
  syncNextId(c.vehicles);
  return c;
}

function saveConfig() {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(config)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

function encodeConfig(c) {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(c));
  let bin = '';
  for (const b of bytes) bin += String.fromCharCode(b);
  return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

function decodeConfig(s) {
  try {
    const bin = atob(s.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'));
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(bin, (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0))));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- length inputs

export function parseLength(str) {
  const s = String(str).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[’′]/g, "'").replace(/[”″]/g, '"');
  if (!s) return NaN;
  let m = s.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:'|ft|feet)\s*(?:(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:"|in|inches)?)?$/);
  if (m) return parseFloat(m[1]) + (m[2] ? parseFloat(m[2]) / 12 : 0);
  m = s.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:"|in|inches)$/);
  if (m) return parseFloat(m[1]) / 12;
  if (/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(s)) return parseFloat(s);
  return NaN;
}

const fmtNum = (v) => String(Math.round(v * 100) / 100);

function bindLength(input, get, set, { min = 0, max = 1000 } = {}) {
  input.value = fmtNum(get());
  input.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const v = parseLength(input.value);
    const ok = Number.isFinite(v) && v >= min && v <= max;
    input.classList.toggle('invalid', !ok);
    input.title = ok ? '' : `Enter a length between ${min} and ${max} ft`;
    if (!ok) return;
    set(v);
    input.value = fmtNum(v);
    configChanged();
  });
}

function el(tag, attrs = {}, ...children) {
  const e = document.createElement(tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
    if (k === 'class') e.className = v;
    else if (k.startsWith('on')) e.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
    else if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== false) e.setAttribute(k, v === true ? '' : v);
  }
  for (const c of children) if (c != null) e.append(c);
  return e;
}

function lengthField(label, get, set, opts) {
  const input = el('input', { class: 'len' });
  bindLength(input, get, set, opts);
  return el('label', {}, label, input);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- forms

function renderForms() {
  bindLength($('b-width'), () => config.building.width, (v) => { config.building.width = v; }, { min: 8, max: 400 });
  bindLength($('b-depth'), () => config.building.depth, (v) => { config.building.depth = v; }, { min: 8, max: 400 });
  for (const k of ['clearance', 'parkGap', 'endGap']) {
    bindLength($(`s-${k}`), () => config.settings[k], (v) => { config.settings[k] = v; }, { min: 0, max: 10 });
  }
  bindLength($('s-apron'), () => config.settings.apron, (v) => { config.settings.apron = v; }, { min: 0, max: 200 });
  for (const k of ['allowAngled', 'requireExit']) {
    const cb = $(`s-${k}`);
    cb.checked = !!config.settings[k];
    cb.onchange = () => { config.settings[k] = cb.checked; configChanged(); };
  }
  renderDoors();
  renderVehicles();
  renderObstacles();
}

function refreshForms() {
  // Rebind everything from scratch (used after reset / load).
  for (const id of ['b-width', 'b-depth', 's-clearance', 's-parkGap', 's-endGap', 's-apron']) {
    const old = $(id);
    const fresh = old.cloneNode();
    old.replaceWith(fresh);
  }
  renderForms();
}

function renderDoors() {
  const box = $('doors');
  box.replaceChildren();
  config.doors.forEach((d, i) => {
    const wall = el('select', {
      onchange: (e) => { d.wall = e.target.value; configChanged(); },
    }, ...WALLS.map((w) => el('option', { value: w, selected: w === d.wall }, w)));
    box.append(el('div', { class: 'door-row' },
      el('label', {}, `Door ${i + 1}`, wall),
      lengthField('Offset', () => d.offset, (v) => { d.offset = v; }, { max: 400 }),
      lengthField('Width', () => d.width, (v) => { d.width = v; }, { min: 1, max: 100 }),
      el('button', { class: 'icon', title: 'Remove door', onclick: () => { config.doors.splice(i, 1); renderDoors(); configChanged(); } }, '✕'),
    ));
  });
}

function vehicleById(id) {
  return config.vehicles.find((v) => v.id === id);
}

function describeVehicle(v) {
  return `${fmtFt(v.length)} × ${fmtFt(v.width)} · turning circle ${fmtFt(v.turningCircle)}`;
}

function renderVehicles() {
  const box = $('vehicles');
  box.replaceChildren();
  config.vehicles.forEach((v, i) => {
    const move = (delta) => {
      const j = i + delta;
      if (j < 0 || j >= config.vehicles.length) return;
      [config.vehicles[i], config.vehicles[j]] = [config.vehicles[j], config.vehicles[i]];
      renderVehicles();
      configChanged();
    };
    const color = el('input', { type: 'color', value: v.color, class: 'swatch', title: 'Colour' });
    color.style.padding = '0';
    color.style.width = '22px';
    color.style.height = '22px';
    color.oninput = () => { v.color = color.value; saveConfig(); requestDraw(); renderResults(); };
    const name = el('input', { class: 'name', value: v.name });
    name.onchange = () => { v.name = name.value; saveConfig(); requestDraw(); renderResults(); };

    const pinInfo = v.pin
      ? el('span', {}, el('span', { class: 'pin' }, '📌 pinned '),
        el('button', { class: 'icon', title: 'Let the planner choose the spot', onclick: () => { v.pin = null; renderVehicles(); configChanged(); } }, 'unpin'))
      : el('button', {
        class: 'icon', title: 'Pin this vehicle to a spot you choose (then drag it on the plan)',
        onclick: () => { pinVehicle(v); renderVehicles(); configChanged(); },
      }, 'pin');

    const m = vehicleModel(v);
    const details = el('details', {},
      el('summary', {}, 'Dimensions'),
      el('div', { class: 'grid3' },
        lengthField('Length', () => v.length, (x) => { v.length = x; }, { min: 4, max: 60 }),
        lengthField('Width (body)', () => v.width, (x) => { v.width = x; }, { min: 2, max: 12 }),
        lengthField('Width (mirrors)', () => v.mirrorWidth, (x) => { v.mirrorWidth = x; }, { min: 2, max: 14 }),
        lengthField('Wheelbase', () => v.wheelbase, (x) => { v.wheelbase = x; }, { min: 2, max: 40 }),
        lengthField('Front overhang', () => v.frontOverhang, (x) => { v.frontOverhang = x; }, { min: 0, max: 10 }),
        lengthField('Turning circle', () => v.turningCircle, (x) => { v.turningCircle = x; }, { min: 10, max: 120 }),
      ),
      el('p', { class: 'hint' }, `Turning circle is the curb-to-curb diameter from the spec sheet. Gives a minimum rear-axle turning radius of ${fmtFt(m.rMin)}.`),
    );
    details.open = openDetails.has(v.id);
    details.ontoggle = () => (details.open ? openDetails.add(v.id) : openDetails.delete(v.id));

    box.append(el('div', { class: 'item' },
      el('div', { class: 'item-head' },
        color, name,
        el('button', { class: 'icon', title: 'Move up (parks earlier)', onclick: () => move(-1) }, '↑'),
        el('button', { class: 'icon', title: 'Move down (parks later)', onclick: () => move(1) }, '↓'),
        el('button', {
          class: 'icon', title: 'Remove vehicle',
          onclick: () => { config.vehicles.splice(i, 1); renderVehicles(); configChanged(); },
        }, '✕'),
      ),
      el('div', { class: 'dims' }, describeVehicle(v), pinInfo),
      details,
    ));
  });
}

function renderObstacles() {
  const box = $('obstacles');
  box.replaceChildren();
  config.obstacles.forEach((o, i) => {
    box.append(el('div', { class: 'obst-row' },
      lengthField('X', () => o.x, (v) => { o.x = v; }, { max: 400 }),
      lengthField('Y', () => o.y, (v) => { o.y = v; }, { max: 400 }),
      lengthField('W', () => o.w, (v) => { o.w = v; }, { min: 0.1, max: 400 }),
      lengthField('D', () => o.d, (v) => { o.d = v; }, { min: 0.1, max: 400 }),
      el('button', { class: 'icon', title: 'Remove', onclick: () => { config.obstacles.splice(i, 1); renderObstacles(); configChanged(); } }, '✕'),
    ));
  });
}

function setupStaticControls() {
  const preset = $('preset');
  for (const [k, p] of Object.entries(PRESETS)) preset.append(el('option', { value: k }, p.label));
  preset.value = 'medium';
  $('add-vehicle').onclick = () => {
    config.vehicles.push(newVehicle(preset.value, config.vehicles.length));
    renderVehicles();
    configChanged();
  };
  $('add-door').onclick = () => {
    config.doors.push({ wall: 'front', offset: 1, width: 9 });
    renderDoors();
    configChanged();
  };
  $('add-obstacle').onclick = () => {
    config.obstacles.push({ x: config.building.width / 2 - 0.5, y: config.building.depth / 2 - 0.5, w: 1, d: 1 });
    renderObstacles();
    configChanged();
  };
  $('btn-run').onclick = () => runPlan('plan', { animate: true });
  $('btn-explore').onclick = () => runPlan('explore', { animate: true });
  $('btn-cancel').onclick = cancelJob;
  $('btn-play').onclick = togglePlay;
  $('btn-restart').onclick = () => { anim.t = 0; play(); };
  $('btn-end').onclick = () => { finishAnimation(); };
  for (const id of ['show-paths', 'show-clearance']) $(id).onchange = requestDraw;
  $('btn-reset').onclick = () => {
    if (!confirm('Replace the current setup with the example?')) return;
    config = exampleConfig();
    history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname);
    refreshForms();
    configChanged();
  };
  $('btn-share').onclick = async () => {
    const url = `${location.origin}${location.pathname}#c=${encodeConfig(config)}`;
    history.replaceState(null, '', url);
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      flash($('btn-share'), 'Link copied');
    } catch {
      prompt('Copy this link:', url);
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('input, select, textarea')) return;
    if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); togglePlay(); }
    if ((e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') && hoverId != null) rotateVehicle(hoverId, e.shiftKey ? -90 : 90);
  });
}

function flash(button, text) {
  const old = button.textContent;
  button.textContent = text;
  setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = old; }, 1500);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- planning

let worker = null;
let jobId = 0;
let autoTimer = null;

function configChanged() {
  saveConfig();
  world = buildWorld(config);
  renderer.fit(world.bounds);
  if (result) stale = true;
  renderResults();
  requestDraw();
  if ($('auto-run').checked) {
    clearTimeout(autoTimer);
    autoTimer = setTimeout(() => runPlan('plan', { animate: false }), 400);
  }
}

function cancelJob() {
  if (worker) worker.terminate();
  worker = null;
  $('busy').hidden = true;
}

function runPlan(type, { animate }) {
  clearTimeout(autoTimer);
  cancelJob();
  const snap = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(config));
  const id = ++jobId;
  const trials = Math.max(2, Math.min(200, parseInt($('trials').value, 10) || 20));
  worker = new Worker(new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
  $('busy').hidden = false;
  $('busy-text').textContent = 'Planning…';
  let bestNote = '';
  worker.onmessage = (e) => {
    const msg = e.data;
    if (msg.id !== id) return;
    if (msg.type === 'progress') {
      const what = msg.name === 'exit check' ? 'checking exits' : `parking ${msg.name}`;
      $('busy-text').textContent = type === 'explore'
        ? `Layout ${msg.trial + 1}/${msg.trials}: ${what}${bestNote}`
        : `${what} (${Math.min(msg.step + 1, msg.total)}/${msg.total})…`;
    } else if (msg.type === 'improved') {
      bestNote = ` · best so far ${msg.parkedCount} parked, ${msg.freeExit} free`;
    } else if (msg.type === 'result') {
      cancelJob();
      result = { ...msg.result, snap, mode: type, trials };
      stale = false;
      anim.timeline = buildTimeline(result);
      if (animate) { anim.t = 0; play(); } else finishAnimation();
      renderResults();
    } else if (msg.type === 'error') {
      cancelJob();
      console.error(msg.message);
      $('results').textContent = `Planner error: ${msg.message.split('\n')[0]}`;
    }
  };
  worker.onerror = (e) => {
    cancelJob();
    $('results').textContent = `Could not start the planner (${e.message || 'worker error'}). Serve this page over http(s) rather than opening the file directly.`;
  };
  worker.postMessage({ type, config: snap, id, trials });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- animation

const PAUSE = 2.5; // ft-equivalents spent stopped when changing gear
const GAP = 5; // between vehicles

function buildTimeline(res) {
  const items = [];
  res.results.forEach((r) => {
    if (!r.parked) return;
    const v = res.snap.vehicles.find((x) => x.id === r.id);
    items.push({ r, v, model: vehicleModel(v) });
  });
  items.sort((a, b) => a.r.seq - b.r.seq);
  let t = 0;
  for (const it of items) {
    const p = it.r.path;
    const arrive = new Float64Array(p.length);
    const pause = new Float64Array(p.length);
    for (let i = 1; i < p.length; i++) {
      pause[i] = i > 1 && p[i].dir !== p[i - 1].dir ? PAUSE : 0;
      arrive[i] = arrive[i - 1] + pause[i] + Math.hypot(p[i].x - p[i - 1].x, p[i].y - p[i - 1].y);
    }
    it.arrive = arrive;
    it.pause = pause;
    it.start = t;
    it.end = t + arrive[arrive.length - 1];
    t = it.end + GAP;
  }
  return { items, total: Math.max(0, t - GAP) };
}

function lerpAngle(a, b, u) {
  let d = b - a;
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= 2 * Math.PI;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += 2 * Math.PI;
  return a + d * u;
}

// State of a timeline item at animation time t.
function itemState(it, t) {
  const p = it.r.path;
  const local = t - it.start;
  if (local < 0) return null;
  if (local >= it.end - it.start) {
    const q = p[p.length - 1];
    return { pose: { x: q.x, y: q.y, th: q.th }, steer: 0, upTo: p.length, done: true };
  }
  let lo = 1, hi = p.length - 1;
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (it.arrive[mid] < local) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;
  }
  const i = lo;
  const seg = it.arrive[i] - it.arrive[i - 1] - it.pause[i];
  const u = seg > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (local - it.arrive[i - 1] - it.pause[i]) / seg)) : 1;
  const a = p[i - 1], b = p[i];
  return {
    pose: { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * u, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * u, th: lerpAngle(a.th, b.th, u) },
    steer: b.steer, upTo: i + 1, done: false,
  };
}

function play() {
  if (!anim.timeline) return;
  if (anim.t >= anim.timeline.total) anim.t = 0;
  anim.playing = true;
  anim.last = performance.now();
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

function togglePlay() {
  if (anim.playing) { anim.playing = false; requestDraw(); } else play();
}

function finishAnimation() {
  anim.playing = false;
  if (anim.timeline) anim.t = anim.timeline.total;
  requestDraw();
}

function tick(now) {
  if (!anim.playing) return;
  const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - anim.last) / 1000);
  anim.last = now;
  anim.t += dt * Number($('speed').value);
  if (anim.t >= anim.timeline.total) {
    anim.t = anim.timeline.total;
    anim.playing = false;
  }
  draw();
  if (anim.playing) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

const animDone = () => !anim.timeline || (!anim.playing && anim.t >= anim.timeline.total);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- scene / drawing

let drawQueued = false;
function requestDraw() {
  if (drawQueued) return;
  drawQueued = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { drawQueued = false; draw(); });
}

// Final (or pinned) pose of each vehicle, for dragging and spacing checks.
function restingPoses() {
  const out = new Map();
  if (result) {
    for (const r of result.results) {
      if (!r.parked || !vehicleById(r.id)) continue;
      const v = result.snap.vehicles.find((x) => x.id === r.id);
      out.set(r.id, { v, model: vehicleModel(v), pose: r.pose });
    }
  }
  for (const v of config.vehicles) {
    if (v.pin && !out.has(v.id)) out.set(v.id, { v, model: vehicleModel(v), pose: v.pin, ghost: true });
  }
  if (drag) {
    const cur = vehicleById(drag.id);
    out.set(drag.id, { v: cur, model: vehicleModel(cur), pose: { x: drag.x, y: drag.y, th: drag.th } });
  }
  return out;
}

function draw() {
  const showPaths = $('show-paths').checked;
  const vehicles = [];
  const failedPins = new Set();
  if (result) for (const r of result.results) if (!r.parked) failedPins.add(r.id);

  if (anim.timeline && !drag) {
    for (const it of anim.timeline.items) {
      const cur = vehicleById(it.v.id);
      if (!cur) continue;
      const st = itemState(it, anim.t);
      if (!st) continue;
      vehicles.push({
        id: it.v.id, model: it.model, pose: st.pose, steer: st.steer, color: cur.color,
        label: st.done || animDone() ? cur.name : '', path: showPaths ? it.r.path : null, pathUpTo: st.upTo,
        highlight: hoverId === it.v.id && animDone(),
      });
    }
  }
  const shown = new Set(vehicles.map((v) => v.id));
  for (const [id, s] of restingPoses()) {
    if (shown.has(id)) continue;
    const cur = vehicleById(id);
    if (!cur) continue;
    const isDrag = drag && drag.id === id;
    vehicles.push({
      id, model: vehicleModel(cur), pose: s.pose, color: cur.color, label: cur.name,
      ghost: !isDrag && s.ghost, invalid: isDrag ? !drag.valid : failedPins.has(id) && !!cur.pin,
      highlight: hoverId === id,
    });
  }
  renderer.draw({
    world, vehicles,
    options: { showPaths, showClearance: $('show-clearance').checked, clearance: config.settings.clearance },
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- results panel

function renderResults() {
  const box = $('results');
  box.replaceChildren();
  if (!result) return;
  const n = result.results.length;
  const summary = el('div', { class: 'summary' },
    el('span', { class: result.parkedCount === n ? 'ok' : 'bad' }, `${result.parkedCount} of ${n} vehicles parked`),
    ' · ',
    el('span', { class: result.freeExit === result.parkedCount ? 'ok' : 'bad' },
      `${result.freeExit} can drive out without moving others`),
    result.mode === 'explore' ? el('span', { class: 'stale' }, `best of ${result.trials} layouts tried`) : null,
    stale ? el('span', { class: 'stale' }, 'Setup changed since this run.') : null,
  );
  const name = (id) => vehicleById(id)?.name ?? result.snap.vehicles.find((v) => v.id === id)?.name ?? '?';
  const rows = result.results.map((r) => {
    const v = result.snap.vehicles.find((x) => x.id === r.id);
    const cur = vehicleById(r.id);
    const sw = el('span', { class: 'swatch', style: `display:inline-block;background:${cur?.color ?? v.color}` });
    let status;
    if (!r.parked) {
      status = el('span', { class: 'status-bad' }, `✗ Not parked: ${r.reason}`);
    } else {
      const how = r.moves <= 1 ? (r.firstDir < 0 ? 'backs straight in' : 'drives straight in') : `${r.moves}-point manoeuvre`;
      const door = r.door != null ? `Door ${r.door + 1}` : 'door';
      const exit = r.exit?.ok
        ? el('span', { class: 'status-ok' }, '✓ can leave')
        : el('span', { class: 'status-bad' }, r.exit?.blockedBy?.length
          ? `✗ blocked in by ${r.exit.blockedBy.map(name).join(' or ')}`
          : '✗ boxed in (more than one vehicle must move)');
      status = el('span', {},
        `via ${door}, ${how} · `, exit,
        r.spacingOk === false ? el('span', { class: 'status-warn' }, ' · ⚠ tighter than the parked-gap rule') : null,
        vehicleById(r.id)?.pin ? ' · 📌' : null);
    }
    return el('tr', {}, el('td', {}, sw), el('td', {}, el('strong', {}, name(r.id))), el('td', {}, status));
  });
  box.append(summary, el('table', {}, el('tbody', {}, ...rows)));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dragging / pins

function pinVehicle(v) {
  const rest = restingPoses().get(v.id);
  if (rest) {
    v.pin = { ...rest.pose };
  } else {
    const m = vehicleModel(v);
    v.pin = { x: config.building.width / 2, y: config.building.depth / 2 - m.bodyOffset, th: Math.PI / 2 };
  }
}

function snapTh(th) {
  return headingBin(th) * DTH;
}

function hitTest(wx, wy) {
  const poses = [...restingPoses()];
  for (let i = poses.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const [id, s] = poses[i];
    const b = bodyObb(s.model, s.pose.x, s.pose.y, s.pose.th);
    const dx = wx - b.cx, dy = wy - b.cy;
    if (Math.abs(dx * b.c + dy * b.s) <= b.hx && Math.abs(-dx * b.s + dy * b.c) <= b.hy) return id;
  }
  return null;
}

function dragValid(id, x, y, th) {
  const cur = vehicleById(id);
  const others = [];
  for (const [oid, s] of restingPoses()) {
    if (oid !== id) others.push({ body: bodyObb(s.model, s.pose.x, s.pose.y, s.pose.th) });
  }
  return parkValid(world, vehicleModel(cur), x, y, th, others);
}

function rotateVehicle(id, deg) {
  const v = vehicleById(id);
  if (!v || !animDone()) return;
  if (!v.pin) pinVehicle(v);
  const m = vehicleModel(v);
  const cx = v.pin.x + Math.cos(v.pin.th) * m.bodyOffset, cy = v.pin.y + Math.sin(v.pin.th) * m.bodyOffset;
  const th = snapTh(v.pin.th + (deg * Math.PI) / 180);
  v.pin = { x: cx - Math.cos(th) * m.bodyOffset, y: cy - Math.sin(th) * m.bodyOffset, th };
  renderVehicles();
  configChanged();
}

function setupCanvas() {
  const canvas = $('canvas');
  const pointerWorld = (e) => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return renderer.toWorld(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
  };
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const [wx, wy] = pointerWorld(e);
    const id = hitTest(wx, wy);
    if (id == null) return;
    if (!animDone()) finishAnimation();
    const s = restingPoses().get(id);
    drag = { id, dx: s.pose.x - wx, dy: s.pose.y - wy, x: s.pose.x, y: s.pose.y, th: s.pose.th, sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, moved: false, valid: true };
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    const [wx, wy] = pointerWorld(e);
    if (drag) {
      drag.moved ||= Math.hypot(e.clientX - drag.sx, e.clientY - drag.sy) > 3;
      drag.x = wx + drag.dx;
      drag.y = wy + drag.dy;
      drag.valid = dragValid(drag.id, drag.x, drag.y, drag.th);
      requestDraw();
      return;
    }
    const id = animDone() ? hitTest(wx, wy) : null;
    if (id !== hoverId) { hoverId = id; requestDraw(); }
    canvas.style.cursor = id != null ? 'grab' : 'default';
  });
  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag) return;
    const d = drag;
    drag = null;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';
    if (d.moved) {
      const v = vehicleById(d.id);
      v.pin = { x: d.x, y: d.y, th: snapTh(d.th) };
      renderVehicles();
      configChanged();
    }
    requestDraw();
  };
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
  canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    if (hoverId == null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    rotateVehicle(hoverId, (e.deltaY > 0 ? -1 : 1) * (e.shiftKey ? 15 : 5));
  }, { passive: false });

  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    renderer.resize();
    renderer.fit(world.bounds);
    draw();
  });
  ro.observe(canvas.parentElement);
  matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', requestDraw);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- boot

setupStaticControls();
renderForms();
setupCanvas();
runPlan('plan', { animate: true });

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { defaultConfig } from '../js/world.js';
import { newVehicle } from '../js/vehicles.js';
import { planLayout } from '../js/layout.js';
import { parseLength } from '../js/units.js';

const config = (f) => { const c = defaultConfig(); f(c); return c; };

test('three cars fit a standard three-bay garage and can all leave', () => {
  const r = planLayout(config((c) => { c.vehicles = ['medium', 'large', 'small'].map((p, i) => newVehicle(p, i)); }));
  assert.equal(r.parkedCount, 3);
  assert.equal(r.freeExit, 3);
  for (const x of r.results) assert.equal(x.moves, 1);
});

test('a crew-cab pickup cannot clear a 9 ft door with 6 in clearance', () => {
  const r = planLayout(config((c) => { c.vehicles = [newVehicle('pickup')]; }));
  assert.equal(r.parkedCount, 0);
});

test('tandem garage parks two cars, the back one blocked by the front one', () => {
  const r = planLayout(config((c) => {
    c.building = { width: 14, depth: 42, wallThickness: 0.5 };
    c.doors = [{ wall: 'front', offset: 2.5, width: 9 }];
    c.vehicles = ['small', 'medium'].map((p, i) => newVehicle(p, i));
  }));
  assert.equal(r.parkedCount, 2);
  const [back, front] = r.results;
  assert.equal(back.exit.ok, false);
  assert.deepEqual(back.exit.blockedBy, [front.id]);
  assert.equal(front.exit.ok, true);
});

test('pinned spot is honoured', () => {
  const r = planLayout(config((c) => {
    const v = newVehicle('small');
    v.pin = { x: 18, y: 10, th: Math.PI / 2 };
    c.vehicles = [v];
  }));
  const p = r.results[0].pose;
  assert.ok(Math.hypot(p.x - 18, p.y - 10) < 1);
});

test('length parsing', () => {
  assert.equal(parseLength('9'), 9);
  assert.equal(parseLength(`9'6"`), 9.5);
  assert.equal(parseLength('9 ft 6 in'), 9.5);
  assert.equal(parseLength('114"'), 9.5);
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(parseLength('abc')));
});
EOF

cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Parking Buddy

Will your vehicles fit in the garage or barn you're planning? Parking Buddy lets
you set the building size and doors, pick some vehicles, then simulates driving
each one in. Each vehicle steers within its real turning circle, keeps clearance
from walls, door jambs and other vehicles, and backs up when it needs to.

It's a static web app: plain HTML, CSS and ES modules with no build step and no
dependencies.

## Running

Serve the directory over HTTP. Opening `index.html` as a `file://` URL won't
work, because the planner runs in a module Web Worker.

```sh
npm start            # or: python3 -m http.server 8000
# open http://localhost:8000
```

To deploy, copy `index.html`, `css/` and `js/` to any static host.

## Using it

- **Building**: interior width and depth. Lengths accept `9.5`, `9'6"`, `9 ft 6 in` or `114"`.
- **Doors**: any number, on any wall. Each has an offset along the wall and a width.
- **Vehicles**: start from a preset (compact car, compact SUV, large SUV, crew-cab
  pickup, sports car) and edit the dimensions. Use the spec-sheet *curb-to-curb
  turning circle*, and the width across the mirrors. Mirrors are often what
  decides whether a vehicle gets through a door.
- **Obstacles**: posts, benches, stairs, as rectangles.
- **Rules**: clearance while moving, the side gap needed to open doors when parked,
  the end gap, the driveway apron depth, whether angled parking is allowed, and
  whether to try to keep every vehicle free to leave.

**Run simulation** parks the vehicles in list order and animates them.
**Explore layouts** tries many random parking orders and spot choices, then keeps
the best result. "Best" means the most vehicles parked, then the most that can
leave without moving anything, then the fewest manoeuvres.

To tell it where you want a vehicle, **drag it on the plan**. That pins it. Scroll
the mouse wheel over a vehicle to rotate it 5° (hold Shift for 15°), or press `R`
to rotate it 90°. Pinned vehicles are parked first, and the others work around
them. With *auto-run* on, every change re-plans right away.

**Copy share link** puts the whole setup in the URL. The setup is also saved in
the browser's local storage.

## How it works

- `js/planner.js`: a Hybrid-A*-style search over (x, y, heading) using a
  kinematic bicycle model. The minimum radius at the rear axle comes from the
  curb-to-curb turning circle. Motion primitives go forward and in reverse, at full
  and half steering lock, and each turns by exactly one 5° heading bin, so
  headings stay exact. The search runs as a Dijkstra flood from entry poses
  outside each door, which finds every pose the vehicle can reach in one pass.
  Costs penalise reversing, steering and changing direction.
- `js/layout.js`: parks vehicles one at a time. For each one, it scores every
  reachable pose that meets the spacing rules, then picks the best. The score
  rewards being deep in the building, snug against walls and other vehicles, and a
  simple manoeuvre. It penalises blocking door lanes or earlier vehicles' paths.
  Afterwards it checks that each vehicle can drive out. It first tries reversing
  the vehicle's own entry path; if that's blocked, it searches. It also reports
  which vehicle is in the way.
- `js/explore.js`: random-restart search over parking order and spot choice.
- `js/render.js`, `js/main.js`: canvas drawing, UI, animation, drag-to-pin.

## Limitations

- The model is 2D only. Overhead doors, lifts and roof posts are not checked for height.
- The planner works on a 0.5 ft / 5° grid. In very tight spots (less than about
  0.25 ft spare) it can miss a manoeuvre that exists, so treat "doesn't fit" there
  as "very tight".
- The automatic layout is heuristic. Use *Explore layouts* or pins to look for
  better arrangements.

## Tests

```sh
npm test       # planner scenarios (Node 20+)
npm run bench  # timing and scenario printout
```
EOF

I've built a working first version of Parking Buddy. It's a static web app with no dependencies and no build step. Run npm start (or python3 -m http.server 8000) and open http://localhost:8000. It has to be served over HTTP; opening index.html directly won't work.

The 5 automated tests pass, and I tested it in headless Chromium: the animation, the results panel, drag-to-pin, rotating, explore mode and phone width all work with no console errors.

What you get: - Inputs: building size, any number of doors on any wall, obstacles such as posts, and vehicles from five presets (compact car, compact SUV, large SUV, crew-cab pickup, sports car) whose dimensions you can edit. Lengths accept 9'6" as well as decimals. - Rules: clearance while moving, side gap when parked (room to open doors), end gap, driveway apron depth, whether angled parking is allowed, and whether to try to keep every vehicle free to leave. - Simulation: each car drives in from outside a door, turning no tighter than its turning circle and reversing when it needs to. Its path is drawn, with reversing shown dashed. - Results panel: for each vehicle it shows whether it parked, which door it used, how many manoeuvres it took (straight in, 3-point turn, etc.), and whether it can drive out or which car is blocking it.

How I handled the two design questions you raised: - "Best arrangement": the default run parks cars in list order, picking spots that are deep in the building, need a simple manoeuvre, and don't block door lanes or earlier cars' paths. Explore layouts tries many random parking orders and spot choices and keeps the best: most cars parked, then most that can leave freely, then fewest manoeuvres. - User hints: drag any car on the plan to pin it there. Scroll the mouse wheel over it to rotate, or press R to turn it 90°. With auto-run on, the planner re-plans around the pinned cars.

Decisions I made that you might want to change: - Turning model: I use the curb-to-curb turning circle from spec sheets to work out each vehicle's tightest turn. - Mirrors: mirrors are modelled separately from the body, because they're usually what decides whether a car gets through a door. With the default 6-inch clearance, the pickup preset (8 ft across the mirrors) doesn't fit a 9 ft door. I think that's realistic, but it's the kind of result you'll want to sanity-check. - Units: feet only, for now. - 2D only: door heights and anything overhead aren't checked.

Limitations: - Very tight spots: the planner works on a 0.5 ft / 5° grid. With less than about 3 inches to spare, it can miss a manoeuvre that a real driver could make, so treat "doesn't fit" there as "very tight". - Speed: a plan takes 1–3 seconds for 3–5 cars. Explore mode multiplies that by the number of trials; the 5-car barn I tested took about 16 seconds for 12. - Automatic layout: the spot scoring is my own rule of thumb, tuned on a few garage shapes. With the example 3-bay garage it parks each car centred and straight in. In odder buildings the first layout can be poor, which is what Explore layouts and pins are for.

The code is in js/: planner.js does the path search, layout.js picks spots and checks exits, explore.js does the random trials, and main.js and render.js are the UI. The README explains the design. Nothing is committed yet; say if you'd like me to commit it.

I tested this and the code already works the way you describe. Two cars parked side by side share one 2.5 ft gap between their bodies, not 5 ft.

Body-to-body gap Allowed with the 2.5 ft side-gap rule?
1 / 2 / 2.4 / 2.5 ft no
2.6 / 5 ft yes

(The rule gives each parked car a 2.5 ft margin and checks it against the bare body of the car next to it, not that car's margin.)

So what you saw probably came from something else. My best guesses:

  1. The rule also applies at walls. A car beside a wall must keep 2.5 ft from it too, so two cars side by side between two walls need three gaps. In a narrow building, that can look like each car is getting a gap on both sides.
  2. The automatic spot choice, not the rule. Cars often end up further apart than the minimum. They tend to park centred behind a door, or wherever their manoeuvre lands them. The planner doesn't push cars together to the tightest legal spacing.
  3. The clearance checkbox. It draws the dashed moving-clearance outline around every car, so neighbours appear to each have their own band. That's only the clearance while driving; it isn't the parked gap.

Could you click Copy share link for the setup where you saw it and paste it here? Then I can see exactly which of these it is.

If it's case 1, one change I could make is to allow a smaller gap on the side of a car that faces a wall. That would cover something like a passenger who can get out on the other side, or a car tucked against a wall. Let me know if you'd want that.
